title: Protocol for the purification of total DNA from soil samples
author: Ruslan Kalendar
materials: The DNA solutions from both Falcon tubes are combined and the pooled DNA solution can be stored in 2-5 ml microtubes.

steps.title: Grind Soil Sample
steps.instruction: Grind the sample at -80°C using a mortar or stirrer chilled to -80°C, or by freezing in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Prepare Soil Sample with CTAB
steps.instruction: Place a sample of homogenized soil (weighing no more than 5 grams) into a 50 ml Falcon tube and add CTAB solution (2% CTAB, 1.5 M NaCl, 10 mM Na 3 EDTA, 0.1 M HEPES-acid, pH 5.3) to a final volume of 40 ml.

steps.title: Incubate and Stir Sample
steps.instruction: Stir the mixture very vigorously on a stirrer and incubate overnight at 65°C.

steps.title: Clarify Soil Sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the soil sample tubes in a large tube centrifuge at +4°C for 10 minutes at 10,000 rpm to clarify and precipitate the soil.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Separate the clarified supernatant into two equal portions of 20 ml each and transfer them into new 50 ml Falcon tubes containing 20 ml of 100% isopropanol cooled to -20°C; mix vigorously on a stirrer.

steps.title: Collect DNA Precipitate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at +4°C for 10 minutes at 10,000 rpm and discard any supernatant to obtain the brown DNA precipitate at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Wash DNA Precipitate
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 70% ethanol and centrifuge to collect.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 ml of 70% ethanol to the Falcon tubes containing the pellet.
Mix the precipitate well on a stirrer.
Centrifuge the tubes at +4°C for 3 minutes at 10,000 rpm.

steps.title: Dissolve DNA Precipitate
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant alcohol solution completely without drying the pellet, then resuspend the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Immediately add 1 ml of 1x TE solution to the precipitate.
Incubate at 65°C until the DNA precipitate is completely dissolved.
